title: Voting Arrangements to Improve Voting Accessibility in Future Elections
what_it_is: Voting Arrangements to Improve Voting Accessibility in Future Elections

sections.label: Ageing electorate and overseas registrations
sections.summary: 21% of Singapore Citizens in the Registers of Electors were aged 65 and above in GE2020, up from 14% in GE2011, and 6,500 overseas citizens registered to vote in GE2020, up from 3,500 in GE2011.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: First, the electorate is ageing rapidly: 21% of Singapore Citizens in the Registers of Electors were aged 65 and above in GE2020, from 14% in GE2011.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In spite of the challenges of the pandemic, 6,500 overseas citizens registered to vote in GE2020, from just 3,500 in GE2011.

sections.label: Piloting voting at nursing homes
sections.summary: ELD is looking at piloting this arrangement for voters residing at some nursing homes, so nursing homes will no longer need to bring elderly voters to polling stations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: ELD is looking at piloting this arrangement for voters residing at some nursing homes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: With this in place, there will no longer be a need for nursing homes to bring their elderly voters staying with them to the polling stations to vote.

sections.label: Studying postal voting for overseas Singaporeans
sections.summary: ELD is studying introducing postal voting for overseas Singaporeans to mail in votes, and expects to engage the public and stakeholders on piloting these initiatives mid-year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: ELD is thus studying if we can introduce postal voting and allow overseas Singaporeans to mail in their votes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: ELD expects to engage the public and key stakeholders, such as the political parties, nursing homes and overseas Singaporeans, on the possibility of piloting these initiatives sometime in the middle of this year.
